newsitem.title: USA: Firstmerit ups share repurchase program.
newsitem.headline: Firstmerit ups share repurchase program.

text.p: Firstmerit Corp said its board of directors authorized the company to repurchase another 1.5 million shares of its common stock, representing 4.8 percent of its currently outstanding common shares.
The company said in a statement that the purchases will be made from time to time in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions.

FirstMerit, a $5.3 billion bank holding company with operations throughout the state of Ohio, said it had already purchased 1.2 million shares under a previously announced 1.5 million share repurchase program that began in the third quarter of 1996.
